title: A few pointers
slide_intent: Give writers an editing sequence that brings the reader’s purpose and the essential information forward.
strategic_value: Specific alternatives to stock phrases can help the museums sound conversational even when different people write the copy.
demonstration: Columns progress from planning questions and paragraph advice through spoken-word substitutions to lists of discouraged words and expressions.
practical_value: Identify the audience and first fact to communicate, then simplify the opening sentence and remove vague intensifiers or familiar clichés.

content_islands.name: Planning and paragraph order
content_islands.spec: Group audience questions, length guidance and the importance of the first sentence in the left column.

content_islands.name: Spoken alternatives
content_islands.spec: Place word substitutions and advice on adjectives and adverbs in the next column.

content_islands.name: Words and expressions lists
content_islands.spec: Give the two lists their own columns so an editor can scan for a word or stock phrase while revising.
